notes:
Inbound from mobile chat plugin — self-serve lead. Signed up for hosted API free trial 2025-09-15; integrated SDK into Unity prototype. Short-hand notes from calls/emails:
- 2025-09-16: Intro call (CTO Aria Patel, eng lead Jonah). Quick demo of existing chat; they are using a lightweight RNN fallback today. Wants to replace with LLM-powered NPC + player chat.
- 2025-09-22: Dev sync w/ SE Evan B. Confirmed streaming works in prototype (basic messages streaming). "Need end-to-end perceived latency <200ms on mobile over LTE" — direct quote from Aria.
- 2025-09-30: Test results: token gen p95 ~140ms on our low-cost hosted test model (mobile message sizes avg 24 tokens). They call this 'acceptable but want headroom'.
- 2025-10-02: Follow-up re: moderation: need profanity filtering, spam/hyperlink blocking, and user reporting webhooks. Also asked about automated fallback to smaller model when load spikes.
- 2025-10-08: Security questionnaire submitted (basic SOC2 items omitted). SE reviewed audit_logging + retention_controls options.
POC milestones: integrated SDK -> streaming validated -> moderation hooks next -> run 2-day soak at 100 concurrent users.
Notes: very cost-sensitive (indie publisher funding runway). Typical concurrent active users expected 50-200 during peaks; average message length short. Interested in intelligent batching, prefix caching. Prefers hosted API for fast iteration; may consider Dedicated only if scale/cost demands later.
Stated preferences: 'prefer small efficient models unless quality tradeoff is obvious' — CTO. Wants routing fallback to quantized variants during spikes.
Open items: clarify logs retention default, data residency (EU users small but ask later), confirm SLA and throttling behavior for bursts.
